node.title: DSP8 single-quotient candidate compressor
node.statement: For a one-lift product-star packet, the ideal generated by all normalized star differences and one product-to-quotient coupling is exactly independent of the chosen star center and remains nonzero even when that coupling vanishes. Thus the (36,1) packet needs no nonzero-anchor designation or zero-locus test for completeness. At official primes its exact quotient-index-free support is p|s_(n,35)^X, equivalently some target has P>=36,R>=1, equivalently Dbar_17>0; the cutoff hierarchy gives s_(n,35)^X|s_(n,18)^X. This is a candidate compressor, not an annihilator algorithm, factorization, moment bound, or C36 close.
